name: Open a PR from the list and load its review detail
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, click into PR #482 and confirm the detail route loads with the PR title and review surface. Also asserts the COST column carries the seeded run cost (L01, specs/0001-run-cost-badge.md) and that the FINDINGS column header renders (L01, specs/0002-findings-badges.md) — proving both survive the real server round-trip. Exercises nested routing (/repos/<id>/pulls/<number>) and the per-PR detail fetch. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where the demo repo acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by the e2e-web.yml workflow's fresh seed; run locally against a clean DB (see e2e/README.md).
